DefaultSceneDocumentView.Name: Default view for scene documents
DefaultSceneDocumentView.Hint: Choose which reader opens by default when a Runyth Scriptoria document is opened from a scene.

StockFoundryLook.Name: Stock Foundry look
StockFoundryLook.Hint: Keep the stock Foundry UI design for the windows of Runyth Scriptoria. By default they use the fleet-wide Garb & Grime look.

DebugLogging.Name: Enable Runyth Scriptoria debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Write focused Runyth Scriptoria diagnostics to the browser console without logging imported document content.

RootFolder.Name: Root Item folder
RootFolder.Hint: The root Item Directory folder used for documents created by Runyth Scriptoria.

CreateKindFolders.Name: Create document-kind subfolders
CreateKindFolders.Hint: Sort generated Items into type-specific folders.

DefaultAccess.Name: Default world Item access
DefaultAccess.Hint: Choose whether a new world Item is hidden until held or placed, or immediately visible to all players.

EnableSceneDrop.Name: Create readable Journal notes on Scene drop
EnableSceneDrop.Hint: Dropping a Runyth Scriptoria Item onto a Scene creates a Journal snapshot and Note at the drop position.

ScenePlayerAccess.Name: Scene Journal player access
ScenePlayerAccess.Hint: Control whether all players can open Journals generated by dropping Runyth Scriptoria Items onto Scenes.

OpenAfterCreate.Name: Open reader after creation
OpenAfterCreate.Hint: Immediately display the reading view after a new Runyth Scriptoria Item is created.

RememberImporterWindow.Name: Remember importer window position and size
RememberImporterWindow.Hint: Restore the Markdown/HTML importer window's last size and placement separately in this browser.

ImporterWindowLayout.Name: Importer window layout
ImporterWindowLayout.Hint: Internal client-specific storage for the importer window's validated dimensions and coordinates.

ResetImporterWindow.Name: Reset importer window position and size
ResetImporterWindow.Label: Reset importer window
ResetImporterWindow.Hint: Clear the layout remembered by this browser. The next importer opens at its default centered placement.
ResetImporterWindow.Confirm: Clear the importer window position and size remembered by this browser?
ResetImporterWindow.Note: The next importer window will use Runyth Scriptoria's default dimensions and centered placement.
ResetImporterWindow.Success: Runyth Scriptoria importer window position and size reset.
